تبتدرون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِرُونَ (tabtadirūna) /tab.ta.di.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# تُبْتَدَرُونَ (tubtadarūna) /tub.ta.da.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
